title: 架子上的小陶碗
summary: 一只蓝色小陶碗，把店里的灯光和隐藏的小花带回家。
scene: 你和同行者在快打烊的小店发现陶碗，并带回家使用。

references.unit: 必修第一册：阅读关系、建议组织和生活听力的局部任务
references.alignment: 依据原作者2026-10-11实际核读八页完整提取正文的记录，借鉴段落主旨、情感依据、建议与理由、出行准备和分阶段指令任务。公开社区PDF存档，版次未核实；未渲染图版或听教材音轨，不声称通读全册或全国进度一致。结构适配未新增教材查阅。

references.unit: 必修第一册：完成事项、当前进展和时间表
references.alignment: 沿用原作者2026-10-11该页全部提取正文、时态描述和准备表核读记录，仅为语境与信息组织背景，不作为本组听力测量的直接依据；未目视图版，结构适配未新增教材查阅。

authorship.author: Astra 高一独立作者
authorship.reviewedBy: 主代理逐题主审；高一结构适配代理逐项核对
authorship.reviewNotes: 手工逐题适配18题，保留主审后全文、候选、答案及解析；程序仅验证。完整双语故事拆为两个题前镜头；两道多空题显式保留每空原候选范围。三段音频pending且无assetId，不可直接发布。两项目标待登记，跨库混编与原生连续作答待验。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: You and your companion stop at a small shop near closing time. On a low shelf sits a blue bowl with an uneven edge. You pick it up, turn it slowly, and notice a tiny flower painted inside. Your companion holds it towards the lamp, and the dark blue becomes bright.
beats.translation: 快打烊时，你和同行者走进一家小店。矮架上放着一只边缘不太整齐的蓝色陶碗。你拿起来慢慢转动，发现碗里画着一朵小花。同行者把碗举向灯光，深蓝色一下子明亮起来。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: You buy the bowl and carry it home in both hands. That evening, you place it on the table and fill it with a few oranges. The little flower is hidden now, but you know where to find it.
beats.translation: 你买下陶碗，双手捧着带回家。当晚，你把它放在桌上，装进几只橙子。小花被遮住了，但你知道到哪里找它。

questions.instruction: 阅读短文，选择指代对象。
questions.prompt: 阅读：The school website lists clubs by name. The new guide groups them by the days they meet. This makes it easier for students to find activities that fit their week. 末句This指哪一做法？

options.text: Putting club names on the school website.
Organising clubs according to their meeting days.
Asking students to choose a different club each week.

questions.hint: 把指代词放回前文，检查所选做法能否解释后面的作用。
questions.explanation: 末句说明新指南按活动日分组的作用。a是旧网站的呈现方式；c把按周安排筛选变成每周换社团。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一基础提升，三句约40词；跨句回指完整做法。

questions.instruction: 逐人配对可行工作，右侧有一项不用。
questions.prompt: 志愿活动说明：Morning helpers must arrive by 8:30 and stay until 10:00. Afternoon helpers must be free from 14:00 to 15:30. Students who cannot attend either session can prepare name cards at home. 将每人的情况与可行工作配对。每项用一次，右侧有一项不用。

left.text: Rui can arrive at 8:15 but must leave at 9:40. She is free after 13:00.
Zoe has a class from 11:00 to 16:00. She is free before that.
Ibrahim is away all day but has time at home that evening.

questions.hint: 对照每人的完整时间安排，再检查工作要求是否全部满足。
questions.explanation: Rui无法留到上午十点，但下午完整有空；Zoe上午有空而下午上课；Ibrahim不能到场，晚上能在家制作。没有人能参加两个完整时段。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，需做三次条件核对；共同规则与个人约束整合。

questions.instruction: 听说明，选择符合要求的一项。
questions.prompt: 听设备借用说明，选择符合说明的做法。

audio.text: Most of the cameras can go back on the shelf after use. Keep the one with the loose cover on my desk, though. I need to repair it before anyone borrows it again.

options.text: Put every camera on the shelf and mark the damaged one.
Leave the cameras on the desk until all of them are checked.
Return the others to the shelf and leave the damaged one on the desk.

questions.hint: 听清每项要求适用于哪些设备。
questions.explanation: 大多数相机用后上架，盖子松动的那台留桌上待修。a把例外也上架；b把针对一台的限制扩大到全部。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，约35词音频；听力中的例外范围，尚待制作及核听。

questions.instruction: 使用全部词块，按要求组成三句回复。
questions.prompt: 同学把小组报告从头读到尾，听众很难知道重点。用全部词块组成三句回复：先承认准备充分，再提出改善重点表达的建议，最后说明作用。
questions.hint: 检查每句话的功能与题目指定的顺序是否相符。
questions.explanation: You've prepared plenty of material. Try pausing briefly after each key idea. That will help listeners identify the main points. 暂停标出重点，而不是要求增加更多材料。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等；5块，三句逻辑结构；建议文本的衔接与交际结构。

questions.instruction: 阅读材料，判断末句的作用。
questions.prompt: 阅读：Lena expected the interview to give her enough material for an article. It lasted an hour, and she filled six pages with notes. Yet when she began writing, she realised that she still could not explain how the club had started. 最后一句主要起什么作用？

options.text: It shows that a large amount of material did not answer an important question.
It explains why the interview had to finish earlier than planned.
It shows how writing helped Lena discover when the club began.

questions.hint: 把最后一句与前两句联系起来，核对每项说法的依据。
questions.explanation: 一小时、六页笔记构成材料充足的预期，最后却发现关键背景缺失。b没有时间依据；c把仍不清楚说成已经发现。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，约45词；转折的具体语篇作用。

questions.instruction: 摘录原文连续四词，只填写空缺部分。
questions.prompt: 规则：The art room is open to everyone at lunchtime. After four, students need a teacher with them. 根据规则，用原文连续四个英文词补全摘要，只填空：Students can use the room at lunchtime, but after four they need ___.
questions.hint: 核对摘要中的时间条件，并遵守连续四词的摘录要求。
questions.explanation: 下午四点后需要教师陪同，完整短语是a teacher with them。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一基础提升，文本摘录非词形变化；保留条件差异的摘要补全。

questions.instruction: 每空按指定候选范围选一项，完成两空。
questions.prompt: 分别选择两个空格的内容，使整段前后连贯。第1空仅从For example、However、As a result中选择；第2空仅从the first path、both paths、the second path中选择。
questions.passage: The old map shows a path beside the river. {g1}, the entrance to that path is now closed. A second path runs behind the houses. Visitors should use {g2} to reach the garden.
questions.hint: 填好后通读整段，检查句间关系和所指对象是否一致。
questions.explanation: 第一空标出地图呈现与当前可用性的反差；入口关闭后应采用另一条路。入口关闭不是地图画出小路的结果，也不是例子。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，两步信息衔接；两空分别承担转折与指代选择。

questions.instruction: 听学习交流，选择针对当前困难的建议。
questions.prompt: 听学习交流，选择下一步最直接针对所说困难的做法。

audio.text: I know what each sentence means when I read slowly. But after I finish a paragraph, I can't tell which sentence gives the main point and which ones explain it. Looking up more words hasn't helped with that.

options.text: Read the paragraph aloud and practise the difficult sounds.
Mark the paragraph's main point and link the supporting sentences to it.
Make a list of new words and compare their dictionary meanings.

questions.hint: 区分说话人已经会做的事与希望解决的问题。
questions.explanation: 困难在句子之间的主次关系，b直接练习主旨与支持句。a解决发音；c重复已经尝试而未解决当前问题的查词路径。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，约40词；困难诊断与建议匹配，音频待验。

questions.instruction: 阅读短文，选择准确的态度变化。
questions.prompt: 阅读：When our class planned a small garden, I thought the empty corner behind the gym was a poor choice. It looked dark, and few students passed it. Our teacher asked us to watch the corner at different times of day before deciding. At noon, sunlight reached most of the ground. We also found a door that opened onto the lunch area. I still wanted to test the soil, but I no longer wanted to reject the place without trying it. 作者的看法怎样改变？

options.text: From supporting the place to rejecting it because students rarely passed.
From doubting the place to deciding that no further checks were needed.
From rejecting the place to considering it while keeping one question open.

questions.hint: 比较开头与结尾，检查选项有没有遗漏或添加条件。
questions.explanation: 开头不赞成，中午光线和通道提供新证据后愿意尝试，但土壤仍需检查。a颠倒变化；b忽略仍待检查的条件。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中高，约88词，普通词汇；跨句追踪态度与证据，非考试难度校准。

questions.instruction: 使用全部词块，按指定顺序组成通知。
questions.prompt: 两条记录：Visitors entered through the side gate last year. This year visitors are using the front gate because it is wider than the side gate. 用全部词块组成一条今年的通知：先说入口要求，再说明理由，最后对比去年。

tokens.text: although we used the side gate last year.

questions.hint: 根据题面规定的三个功能安排词块，再通读检查衔接。
questions.explanation: Please enter through the front gate because it is wider, although we used the side gate last year. 通知要求正门进入，保留更宽的理由与去年侧门的对比。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，4块；语法难度低于信息组织难度，保留因果和让步背景。

questions.instruction: 选择能解释建议作用的一句。
questions.prompt: 建议草稿：Your notes are very detailed, but finding a fact takes too long. Divide each page into sections with clear headings. ___ 选最能解释该建议为何针对这个问题的一句。

options.text: The headings will show you where to look for each kind of information.
The headings will tell you which facts to leave out when copying your notes.
The headings will put the facts in the order in which the teacher mentioned them.

questions.hint: 核对理由是否直接回应草稿提出的问题。
questions.explanation: 分区标题指明各类信息的位置，直接解决查找慢。b把定位信息改为删选事实，c把分类定位改为恢复课堂讲述顺序；草稿没有提出这两个目标。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一基础提升，三项相近长度；建议与相关理由的语义连接。

questions.instruction: 将每句回复与交际功能配对，右侧有一项不用。
questions.prompt: 三位同学都在讨论一份活动通知。将回复与其最直接的交际功能配对；右侧有一项不用。

left.text: By 'bring something to share', do you mean food or an idea for the discussion?
The date is clear, but could you add the room number before sending it?
I can take photos during the activity. Would that be useful?

right.text: 请求解释已有表达的含义。
请求补上缺少的具体信息。
提出自己能够提供的帮助。
请求改变已确定的活动日期。

questions.hint: 判断每句话希望对方如何回应，不只看问句形式。
questions.explanation: l1已有词语但意思不清；l2知道日期却缺房间；l3主动提供拍照服务。没有一句要求改日期。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，排除仅按问句形式分类；语用意图辨析。

questions.instruction: 摘录原文一个英文词，补全空缺。
questions.prompt: 阅读：Some students sent drawings for the cover; others sent photographs. The editor thanked both groups, but chose a drawing for the front. 用原文一个英文词补全：这里的others是指那些sent ___的学生。
questions.hint: 先明确所指群体，再检查所填词是否来自原文。
questions.explanation: others与提交绘画的学生对照，指提交照片的另一群学生。被选择的封面形式不改变others的范围。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一基础提升，受控摘录；代词回指与对照群体。

questions.instruction: 听说明，选择雨天对应的活动安排。
questions.prompt: 听参观说明。假如今天下雨，参观者会怎样活动？

audio.text: The visit starts indoors with a short talk. After that, we normally walk through the garden. If it rains, we'll stay inside and look at pictures of the plants instead. The starting time won't change.

options.text: They will start later and go straight to the garden.
They will start on time, hear the talk and then view plant pictures indoors.
They will start on time, skip the talk and wait indoors for the rain to stop.

questions.hint: 听清天气条件影响哪一步，并核对完整安排。
questions.explanation: 下雨只把花园步行换为室内看植物图片；开始时间及先听简短介绍都保留。a改了开始时间与顺序；c取消介绍并添加等雨停。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，约40词；听力中条件分支与不变量，音频待验。

questions.instruction: 对照记录，每空在指定候选范围内选一项。
questions.prompt: 依据记录完成简报，每空选择一项。记录：On Tuesday, twelve students tried the reading corner. Nine said it was quiet enough. Three found the chairs uncomfortable. The school will keep the corner open and change the chairs. uncomfortable意为坐着不舒服。第1空仅从seats、opening hours、noise level中选择；第2空仅从replace the seats、shorten the opening hours、move the reading corner中选择。
questions.passage: Most of the students were satisfied with the {g1}. The school decided to {g2} rather than close the reading corner.
questions.hint: 逐空核对记录，确保评价对象与采取的行动没有混淆。
questions.explanation: 九人认可安静程度，不能据此说他们认可座椅；学校针对三人提出的问题换椅子，保留空间开放。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，数字仅用于判断most，不考计算；跨句摘要与信息对象绑定。

questions.instruction: 阅读短文，选择例子说明的观点。
questions.prompt: 阅读：A useful school sign does more than tell people what not to do. Beside the sports field, our old sign said, 'Keep off the grass.' The new one says, 'Please use the path while the young grass grows.' It gives the same direction, but also explains the reason and offers another route. 作者用新旧标牌主要说明什么？

options.text: A sign can explain why visitors should take greater care while walking on the grass.
A sign can invite visitors to suggest a better route around the sports field.
A sign can explain a restriction and show people what to do instead.

questions.hint: 把例子与作者概括相互核对，注意选项所说的行为。
questions.explanation: 新标牌要求走已有小路，说明保护幼草的原因并提供替代行动，支持首句“不止禁止”。a仍允许走草地，只要求更小心；b把指定路线误说成征求新路线建议。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，约55词；主题句与例证关系。

questions.instruction: 比较两条报道，选择准确的关系说明。
questions.prompt: 同学甲写：The film club met for forty minutes, so we had enough time to discuss the ending. 同学乙写：The film club met for forty minutes, but we did not have enough time to discuss the ending. 编辑要合并报道。哪句准确指出两条信息的关系？

options.text: They agree on the meeting's length but differ on whether it allowed enough discussion.
They disagree on the meeting's length but agree that the ending was discussed fully.
They agree that forty minutes was enough but differ on which ending they discussed.

questions.hint: 逐项对齐两条信息，检查一致与分歧分别出现在哪里。
questions.explanation: 两条均为四十分钟，差异在是否足够讨论结尾；连接词呈现各自判断，不能据此改写共同事实。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中等，不考复杂虚拟或时态；跨来源一致事实与冲突评价。

questions.instruction: 读完整篇，选择最合适的标题。
questions.prompt: 阅读：Our class wanted to make a page for students who were new to the school. At first, we listed the questions we remembered asking in September. Then we invited five new students to try the page. They found the answers easy to read, but three could not find the lunch menu. We had placed it under 'School Life', a heading that seemed clear to us. We moved the menu to the front page. Testing did not tell us to rewrite every answer; it showed us where our own experience was no longer enough. 哪句最适合作为文章标题？

options.text: Writing More Answers for New Students
Seeing a School Page Through New Students' Eyes
Choosing the Most Popular School Lunch

questions.hint: 检查标题能否覆盖全文的发展，而不只对应一处细节。
questions.explanation: 试用揭示熟悉学校的人未意识到的查找困难，修改来自新生视角。a误将定位问题当成答案数量不足；c把用于说明问题的菜单当成全文目的。
questions.difficultyReason: 高一中高，约100词；普通校园词汇，主旨与细节层级整合。
